summary: Caesarstone Ltd. furnished an amended notice of meeting and proxy statement (Form 6-K, US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's proxy circular) for its 2026 Annual General Meeting, unchanged for November 25, 2026, with record date October 20, 2026. Following a Section 66(b) request by a shareholder holding sufficient voting rights under the Israeli Companies Law, the board added the re-election of Dr. Ariel Halperin as a director in place of Aviv Ben Horin, who withdrew; Proposals 1, 5 and 6 were revised. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for shareholder-requested agenda additions as a possible activism signal.
